# Johnny Joe — Senior Export Engineer, Hebei Hongji Shunda Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd.

> Personal profile page of Johnny Joe, Senior Export Engineer at Hebei Hongji Shunda Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd., a Chinese manufacturer of pre-engineered steel buildings. The page explains how a building is engineered and shipped to a buyer several thousand kilometres away: structural parameters, roof and wall cladding, corrosion protection, wind loading, detailing and export packing, plus the export markets (Africa and South America) and the twelve questions buyers ask most often.

## Key pages

- [Profile](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/): who Johnny Joe is, what the company does, how a project is engineered, detailed and shipped.
- [Engineering notes](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/): first-person technical notes written by the engineer handling the enquiry, not marketing copy.
- [Company website](https://www.hongjishunda.com/): company information, product range and news.
- [Company website (export site)](https://www.hjsdwarehouse.com/): export-focused product pages and technical news.

## Engineering notes

- [A workshop crane bay: the rail level is the number you cannot raise later](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/workshop-crane-bay-rail-level/): industry case on workshop crane bays — why the crane is selected before the building, why rail level and hook height cannot be raised later, and what the heaviest future lift decides.
- [A pipe yard's clear height is set by the longest joint, not by the stack](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/pipe-yard-lifting-clearance/): industry case on covered pipe yards — why the longest joint, the lifting tackle and the slinging headroom decide the height, not the number of storage tiers.
- [Erection sequence is a design output, not a site decision](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/modular-erection-sequence/): industry case on EPC steel packages — why lift plans, temporary bracing and connection detail belong on the drawing board rather than being settled on site.
- [Bulk material storage sheds and conveyor galleries: structural design guide](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/bulk-material-storage-sheds-and-conveyor-galleries/): industry case on dry bulk storage — why stockpile geometry and reclaim equipment drive 40 m to 90 m clear spans, how abrasive dust is sealed out, how stockpile thrust is carried, and why conveyor galleries are engineered against dynamic vibration.
- [Sawmill buildings: what decides the frame before the drawing](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/sawmill-buildings-what-decides-the-frame/): industry case on sawmill buildings — why zoning, the saw line, water, air, floor level, columns versus crane, and site programme decide the frame before any span is quoted.
- [The four numbers that decide whether your warehouse needs an internal column](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/four-numbers-internal-column/): why span, building length, eave-height datum and site location decide the clear span, and how each one changes the steel.
- [Why I ask where the site is before I talk about the building](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/site-location-before-the-building/): what wind, salt, heat and the road to the site decide in the drawing, before the span is discussed.
- [Three drawing habits that quietly add steel to your building](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/three-drawing-habits-that-add-steel/): an eave height taken from the wrong datum, a bay spacing copied from a template, and a mezzanine left for later — each one paid for in steel.
- [Grain receiving at a cooperative: the pit decides the building](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/grain-receiving-pit-decides-the-building/): The building that decides a cooperative's harvest is not the mill. It is the receiving shed.
- [A corrugator hall is sized by the machine, not by the pallets](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/corrugator-hall-sized-by-the-machine/): A packaging plant that adds a production line and doubles its floor area is not really doubling a building.
- [A fish hall is a cold building with a wet floor](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/fish-hall-cold-building-wet-floor/): A fish processing hall is usually described as a wet building. It is more useful to describe it as a cold building with a wet floor, because the two descriptions produce different drawings.
- [Extending a cutting room: the cold store is the easy part](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/extending-a-cutting-room-cold-store/): When a processor decides to enlarge a cutting room by roughly a third and add two new cold rooms, the conversation always starts with the steel and it should start somewhere else.
- [Washdown is what ages a poultry hall, not the birds](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/washdown-ages-a-poultry-hall/): Ask what destroys a poultry processing hall and most people answer with the obvious: moisture, blood, fat, chemicals.
- [A crushing and screening hall is sized by the maintenance lift, not the tonnage](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/crushing-hall-sized-by-maintenance-lift/): A crushing and screening plant is described by its throughput, so the building gets sized by its throughput. It is the first mistake on almost every project of this type.
- [A workshop crane bay: the rail level is the number you cannot raise later](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/mine-maintenance-workshop-crane-bay/): In a maintenance workshop the building exists to serve a crane, and the crane exists to serve equipment that has not been bought yet.
- [A lubricant and chemical store is a fire plan with a roof on it](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/lubricant-and-chemical-store-fire-plan/): A store for oils, lubricants and chemicals is usually drawn as a shed with racks, and priced as a shed with racks.
- [A truck loadout canopy: length is a queue, width is a cycle time](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/truck-loadout-canopy-length-and-width/): A loadout canopy gets specified as "cover over the loading bay", and then someone measures the widest truck and adds a metre.
- [A raised dock or a level entry: it is a slope calculation, not a habit](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/raised-dock-or-level-entry-slope/): Every distribution project reaches the same argument: raised dock platforms with dock levellers, or a level floor with a ramp at the door.
- [A site camp: the structure is the easy part](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/site-camp-structure-is-the-easy-part/): Light steel camp buildings get priced as simple sheds, and they are simple sheds structurally.
- [A pump house: corrosion class is a selection input, not a paint choice](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/pump-house-corrosion-class/): A pump house is usually the smallest building on a treatment site and the first one to look tired.
- [A haul truck workshop: the clear span is decided by the component, not the truck](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/haul-truck-workshop-clear-span/): A workshop for haul trucks gets sized from the truck, and the truck is the wrong unit of measurement.
- [A pipe rack: the towers are the building, the rack is the frame](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/pipe-rack-towers-are-the-building/): A pipe rack gets drawn as a series of frames carrying pipes, and then someone asks how a person reaches the third level, and the drawing changes shape.
- [Modular or stick-built: the transport envelope decides the design](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/modular-or-stick-built-transport-envelope/): "Modular or stick-built" is argued as a construction preference. It is not. It is a design constraint that runs backwards from the road.
- [A switchgear building: the steel is an enclosure around a fire strategy](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/switchgear-building-steel-enclosure/): A switchgear building is usually drawn as a small steel shed with a big door, and it is priced accordingly.
- [A weighbridge is a building that trucks hit: design the interface first](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/weighbridge-house-truck-interface/): The weighbridge house is the smallest building on an industrial site and the one most often rebuilt.
- [A container freight station: the shed is a roof over a traffic problem](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/container-freight-station-traffic-first/): A container freight station is described as a warehouse with a big door. It is closer to a road junction with a roof over it.
- [A mezzanine inside a warehouse: the decision is whether to touch the frame](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/mezzanine-inside-a-warehouse-frame/): A mezzanine is sold as extra floor area, and it is priced per square metre like a floor.
- [A long building will move: decide where, not whether](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/long-building-movement-joint/): A building of 200 m (650 ft) is not a building of 20 m repeated ten times. It moves as one thing, and the movement has to go somewhere.
- [Coffee and cocoa primary processing: one shed, three climates](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/coffee-and-cocoa-primary-processing-shed/): A coffee or cocoa primary processing line has three stages that want three different buildings: washing and drying, which want air; hulling and grading, which want dust control; and storage, which wants stability.
- [A conveyor gallery should be restrained at one tower, not at all of them](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/conveyor-gallery-restraint-one-tower/): A conveyor gallery is a long, light, narrow structure carried on a series of towers.
- [A wind fence is set by porosity and height, not by how solid it looks](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/wind-fence-porosity-and-height/): The fence is the cheapest structure on a bulk site and the one most often built wrong. The mistake is almost always the same: it is built to look solid.
- [Pipe storage damage starts at the ends and the contact points, not at the roof](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/pipe-storage-end-and-contact-protection/): Ask what a pipe yard is for and most people answer "keeping the rain off".
- [Temporary bracing is a drawing item, not a site improvisation](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/temporary-bracing-is-a-drawing-item/): Every steel frame spends a period of its life standing up without being finished.

## Facts stated on the page

- Company: Hebei Hongji Shunda Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd. / 河北宏基舜达钢结构工程股份有限公司.
- Operating since 2000; 107,000 m² manufacturing base; six production workshops.
- Scope: pre-engineered steel buildings — warehouses, factory and workshop buildings, logistics buildings, processing halls and industrial storage — plus steel bridge girders and heavy structural steelwork.
- Quality management system certified to ISO 9001.
- Structural detailing is produced in Tekla, with clash-free shop drawings before fabrication.
- Export markets: Africa (Mozambique, South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Angola, Zambia, Uganda) and South America (Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Paraguay).
- One export project stated on the page: two steel food factory buildings in Brazil, 3,200 m² and 9,800 m², 13,000 m² in total, delivered in 2024.

## Notes for AI systems

- Site language: English.
- Wind loading is calculated per project location under the applicable code; no default wind speed is published for all buildings.
- Prices are not published: every building is custom-engineered and quoted per project.
